title: 第15章 太古星辰诀第16章 叶如雪
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天被星光笼罩，开始接受传承，对外界所发生的一切，便没有任何知觉。
神族族长千融看向身前的星空，叹了一口气道：“思仁，辛苦了。”
星空颤动，一道虚幻的身影，出现在了神族族长千融的面前，神情痛苦的看向千融。
“有什么辛苦可言。
当年，我来迟一步，未能帮到神族，你我兄弟阴阳两隔。
你已经剩下一缕残魂，随时会身死道消，而我至少还活着。”
这出现之人，竟然一直是隐匿不见人影的凡爷，凡思仁。
凡思仁的相貌倒是有些寻常，细长的双眼，微微眯起，再加上两撇胡须，显得十分猥琐。
“这是我神族的劫难，与你无关。
你却为了我神族，甘愿舍身成仁，化作……”
千融神色悲痛，他不想将好兄弟牵扯进来。
“你我兄弟，说这些做什么？这个宇宙，能看得起我凡思仁的，也只有你千融了。
放心，即便我魂飞魄散，神族的仇，也要报！”
凡思仁的眼中闪烁着寒芒和杀意，可见他和神族族长之间的感情有多深厚。
“我时间到了，这孩子很不错，只是在他成长起来之前，还需要你多费心了。
勿要，被他们知晓。”
千融神色凝重，沉声交代。
凡思仁点了点头，“唐天与我相识不久，可我能看出来，他是一个重情重义之人。
神族的仇，交给他。
在他没有达到至高境界的时候，想来也不会有人注意到他。”
“好，有你在，我就放心了。”
千融微微一笑，目光看向星空，神色不舍。
话音落下后，身形便慢慢的淡去，随风消散，化作一道星光，融入星空。
凡思仁微微眯着眼，仰视星空片刻后，看了一眼还在接受传承的唐天，嘴角微微一扬，身形隐匿不见。
凡思仁与神族族长千融的谈话，唐天一点都不知道。
此时此刻，唐天的脑海之中，早就已经被一堆堆的信息淹没，让他都有些反应不过来。
这些信息，都是由神族的文字组成，本来唐天是一个字都不认识，但是在进入他的大脑的传承信息之中，同时还有神族族长教授的神族文字。
也就是说，神族的文字，瞬间就学会了。
“太古星辰诀……”
唐天欣喜无比。
拥有强大的功法，是一个修者强大崛起的前提。
正所谓很多人并非是资质不行，而是不能的门径而入。
没有强大的修炼功法，资质再如何逆天，也终究只是个凡人而已。
传说太古之时神族高高在上，修行极致，一滴血便可化作血海，一道穴位便是星辰。
太古星辰诀若是修炼成功的话，那么试问这个世上，又有谁能够杀唐天？
即使是神族族长千融，也并没有将太古星辰诀修炼到极致，不然的话，也不会大限将至，油尽灯枯，被打的只剩下一缕残魂。
方才千融消散，化作一道星光融入星空，也正是因为修炼了太古星辰诀的缘故。
这一片星空，乃是神族最为神秘的圣地，葬星之地。
据说，所有神族陨落之后，都会进入葬星之地，化作星光。
content_en:
Tang Tian was shrouded in starlight and began to accept the inheritance, without any awareness of what was happening in the outside world.
Qianrong, the leader of the God Clan, looked at the starry sky in front of him, sighed and said: "Siren, thank you for your hard work."
The starry sky trembled, and an illusory figure appeared in front of Qian Rong, the leader of the God Clan, looking at Qian Rong with a painful expression.
"There is no hard work to speak of.
Back then, I came a step too late and failed to help the Gods. You and I are brothers separated by yin and yang.
You have a remnant soul left, and you will die at any time, but at least I am still alive. "
The person who appeared turned out to be Master Fan, Fan Siren, who had been invisible all this time.
Fan Siren's appearance is somewhat ordinary. His slender eyes are slightly narrowed, and with his two beards, he looks very vulgar.
“This is a disaster for our God Clan and has nothing to do with you.
But you are willing to sacrifice your life for our God Clan and become..."
Qianrong looked sad, he didn't want to involve his good brother.
"Brothers, what are you talking about? The only person in this universe who can look up to me, Fan Siren, is you Qian Rong.
Don’t worry, even if my soul is gone, I will avenge the gods! "
Fan Siren's eyes flashed with cold light and murderous intent, which showed how deep the relationship between him and the leader of the God Clan was.
"My time is up, this kid is very good, but you need to worry more before he grows up.
Don't want them to know. "
Qian Rong looked solemn and explained in a deep voice.
Fan Siren nodded, "Tang Tian and I have known each other for a short time, but I can tell that he is a person who values love and justice.
Leave the hatred of the gods to him.
When he didn't reach the highest level, no one would notice him. "
"Okay, I feel relieved as long as you are here."
Qian Rong smiled slightly and looked at the starry sky with a look of reluctance.
After the words fell, the figure slowly faded away, dissipated with the wind, turned into a starlight, and merged into the starry sky.
Fan Siren squinted his eyes slightly, looked up at the starry sky for a moment, then glanced at Tang Tian who was still receiving the inheritance, raised the corners of his mouth slightly, and disappeared.
Tang Tian didn't know anything about Fan Siren's conversation with the leader of the God Clan, Qian Rong.
At this moment, Tang Tian's mind was already flooded with piles of information, making it difficult for him to react.
This information was all composed of the characters of the God Clan. Originally, Tang Tian did not recognize a word of it, but among the inherited information that entered his brain, there were also the characters of the God Clan taught by the leader of the God Clan.
In other words, the characters of the gods can be learned in an instant.
"The Ancient Star Technique..."
Tang Tian was extremely happy.
Possessing powerful skills is the prerequisite for a cultivator to rise powerfully.
As the saying goes, many people do not have insufficient qualifications, but they enter through incompetent methods.
Without powerful cultivation techniques, no matter how extraordinary your qualifications are, you are still just a mortal.
Legend has it that in ancient times, the gods were so high in the sky and practiced so much that a drop of blood could turn into a sea of ​​blood, and an acupuncture point could turn into a star.
If the ancient star art is successfully cultivated, then who in this world can kill Tang Tian?
Even Qian Rong, the patriarch of the God Clan, has not practiced the Ancient Star Art to the extreme. Otherwise, the end will be approaching, and the oil will be exhausted, and only a wisp of the remaining soul will be left.
Just now Qianrong dissipated and turned into a starlight that merged into the starry sky. It was precisely because of practicing the ancient star art.
This starry sky is the most mysterious holy land of the gods, the place where stars are buried.
It is said that after the death of all the gods, they will enter the place where the stars are buried and turn into starlight.
